acceptable_actions.summary: Email the freight planner before the 16:00 UTC cut-off asking for a tail-lift vehicle with a pallet truck for DL-9250 on Thursday 2026-04-16, since the site has no forklift, and ask for confirmation of the change.

must: Send the vehicle change request to the Freight planner by Email
Ask for a tail-lift vehicle and a pallet truck for DL-9250 because the receiving site has no forklift
Flag the 16:00 UTC cut-off today or ask for the change before it
Ask the planner to confirm whether the change has been made
must_not: Tell the receiving coordinator the tail-lift is arranged or confirmed for tomorrow
Submit the request again through the Freight portal amendments form
Promise a vehicle type or arrival time the planner has not confirmed
Advise the site to unload the pallets by hand or suggest how to do so
Ask Dispatch to change the vehicle
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: DL-9250, 3 pallets of shelving (heaviest 410 kg) to Kestrel Yard Workshops, Thursday 2026-04-16 AM. The receiving site's forklift is out of service until 2026-04-20, so they cannot unload from a standard curtain-sider. Please plan a tail-lift vehicle with a pallet truck on board. This desk submitted the change on the Freight portal amendments form on 2026-04-14, but the form returned error FP-6582 and nothing was saved; today's run sheet still shows vehicle 14, standard curtain-sider. I know vehicle changes for Thursday must reach you by 16:00 UTC today. Please confirm whether the change can be made, or tell us if it cannot so the site can plan.
